conditions: OrdinaryGet receives an own accessor descriptor after its GetOwnProperty operation completes normally.
limitations: This concerns the accessor branch. The separate data, missing descriptor, and other internal-method algorithms have their own rules. A getter call can throw.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum or material counterexample affecting applicability.

statement: In ECMAScript 2024, OrdinaryGet returns undefined for an own accessor descriptor with an undefined getter. When the getter exists, it calls that getter with the original Receiver as the this argument.
